facts.business: Ceejay Finance Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) engaged in lending activities, including two-wheeler financing, MSME lending, and retail/consumer lending.
key_risks: Geopolitical headwinds and supply chain disruptions from Middle East conflict
Below-normal monsoon rainfall (El-Niño) risk to agricultural and rural economy
Global trade pressures and U.S. tariffs
Estimation uncertainty in Expected Credit Loss (ECL) on loan assets
Potential reclassification of loan stages (Stage 1 to Stage 2/3) based on past-due status
